question: Can nested observations of the frozen ridge quadratic concentrate costly verification on exceptional states?
purpose: paper-oriented fallback mechanism; cheap floors are not safety bounds
fit: existing nonnegative group affine regression, UID-weighted; five-fold calibration only
selection: compare both candidates on calibration before evaluating development; no development quantile or group search
runtime_estimate: 16 UID canary 22 seconds; 512 calibration and 1024 development approximately 35 GPU-minutes total, about 9 minutes on four GPUs
scope: frozen forward replay, no new teacher outputs or fitting of C; existing teacher preparation remains charged
downstream: only a useful cheap screen advances to a new independent-KV lifecycle; snapshot discrimination alone is not fallback validation
